name: player_classify_pending_contacts_for_segment
description: Player::ClassifyPendingContactsForSegment routes DI segment hits into pending checkpoint, pickup, player-collision, transfer, world-collision, and preferred-collision queues, copying hit and segment payload into each queued contact.
known_limits: The smoke covers each normal queue route and the recent-hit flag route. It does not exercise allocation failure or every ignored-hit branch. tier S verification is deferred to a coherent Player pending-contact source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x423c20 validates checkpoint parsing, pickup bvol owner resolution, player collision callback type 2, transfer damage-handler gate, surface-normal thresholds, impact-slot recent-hit flag, queue offsets, and copied contact payload fields.
The native smoke verifies representative routing and copied payload for each queue.
